title: Take Damage → Reduce Health
description: Subtracts incoming damage from a Health variable and branches on whether the result is zero or below, emitting a death path.
paste_instructions: STEP 1: Enable Python once per project if you haven't — Edit → Plugins → 'Python Editor Script Plugin'. STEP 2: Click your target Character/Pawn blueprint ONCE in the Content Browser to select it (no need to open it). STEP 3: Window → Output Log → switch the 'Cmd' dropdown to 'Python' (not REPL). STEP 4: Paste the Python block above, press Enter. STEP 5: Open the blueprint's event graph, click Copy T3D below, paste.
